questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Engineering Economics Principles & Time Value of Money (Cash Flow Diagrams, Simple & Compound Interest)
questions.text: Explain the Time Value of Money. Define Cash Flow Diagrams and derive the Single-Payment Compound Amount Factor ($F/P, i, n = (1+i)^n$), Uniform Series Present Worth Factor ($P/A, i, n = \frac{(1+i)^n - 1}{i(1+i)^n}$), Capital Recovery Factor ($A/P, i, n = \frac{i(1+i)^n}{(1+i)^n - 1}$), and Sinking Fund Factor ($A/F, i, n = \frac{i}{(1+i)^n - 1}$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Engineering Economics Principles & Time Value of Money (Cash Flow Diagrams, Simple & Compound Interest)
questions.text: Differentiate between Nominal Interest Rate ($r$) and Effective Annual Interest Rate ($i_e = (1 + r/m)^m - 1$) and continuous compounding ($i_e = e^r - 1$). Calculate the effective annual interest rate for a nominal rate of $12\%$ compounded monthly and compounded daily.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Cash Flow Equivalence Calculations (Present Worth: PW, Future Worth: FW, Annual Worth: AW)
questions.text: Explain Net Present Value (NPV), Present Worth (PW), Annual Worth (AW), and Future Worth (FW) evaluation methods for mutually exclusive projects. Compare alternatives with unequal useful lives using the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of life approach and Study Period approach.

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Project Evaluation Methods (Net Present Value: NPV, Internal Rate of Return: IRR, Payback Period)
questions.text: Define Internal Rate of Return (IRR). Explain the trial-and-error linear interpolation method to calculate IRR ($	ext{IRR} = i_1 + \frac{NPV_1}{NPV_1 - NPV_2}(i_2 - i_1)$). Explain why multiple IRRs can occur in non-conventional cash flows (Descartes' Rule of Signs) and how External Rate of Return (ERR / Modified IRR) resolves this.

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Benefit-Cost Ratio (B/C Ratio) Analysis for Public & Infrastructure Projects
questions.text: Explain the Conventional Benefit-Cost Ratio ($B/C = \frac{B - D}{CR + O\&M}$) and Modified B/C Ratio ($B/C = \frac{B - D - O\&M}{CR}$). Perform Incremental Benefit-Cost ($\Delta B / \Delta C$) analysis to select the best alternative from 4 mutually exclusive public infrastructure projects.

questions.chapter: Chapter 5: Depreciation Methods (Straight Line, Declining Balance, MACRS) & Income Tax Impact
questions.text: Define Depreciation. Derive formulas and calculate annual depreciation charges and book values for an construction equipment costing $\text{NPR } 2,500,000$ with salvage value $\text{NPR } 300,000$ after 8 years using: (a) Straight Line Method (SLM), (b) Declining Balance Method (DBM / Double Declining Balance), and (c) Sum-of-the-Years-Digits Method (SOYDM).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Replacement Analysis, Inflation Effects & Sensitivity Analysis
questions.text: Explain Replacement Analysis of equipment: Defender vs Challenger, Sunk Cost, Opportunity Cost, and Economic Service Life (Minimum EUAC). Explain Sensitivity Analysis and Break-Even Analysis ($Q_{BE} = \frac{FC}{P - VC}$) with cash flow diagrams.
